stories.label: LEAD
stories.headline: USCG Cutter Waesche debuts V-BAT autonomous ISR drone on 113-day Bering Sea patrol
claims_in_post: V-BAT vertical-takeoff drone flew live surveillance off the Waesche, first operational integration of the system on a national security cutter in Alaskan waters
Waesche (WMSL 751), 113-day Bering Sea patrol, ~18,685 nautical miles
first-ever fueling-at-sea with new polar icebreaker USCGC Storis at Dutch Harbor
Vice Adm. Nathan Moore said in April that Chinese and Russian vessel activity near Alaska is rising (April panel, not this patrol; no direct quote)

sources.note: background origin source (2 days before window)

stories.label: SUPPORT
stories.headline: GCI Aleutian subsea fiber break cuts six communities (May 27)
claims_in_post: May 27 GCI subsea fiber cable severed between Larsen Bay and Chignik Bay
internet and wireless cut to six communities (Akutan, Chignik Bay, False Pass, King Cove, Perryville, Unalaska)
repair-vessel transit 7 to 14 days, mobile voice and texting partly restored on backup satellite
second Aleutian subsea break in roughly six months

stories.label: SUPPORT
stories.headline: NSF TechAccess AI-Ready America (NSF 26-508), June 16 LOI deadline
claims_in_post: NSF joint program with the Labor Department funds about $1 million a year for three years per state for an AI workforce coordination hub
Round 1 Letters of Intent due June 16, full proposals July 16, only 10 hubs selected in Round 1
University of Alaska framed as the desk's read of the obvious applicant

sources.note: solicitation predates window; June 16 LOI deadline is the in-window forcing function

stories.headline: Koniag / Tuknik wins 2026 ACT-IAC Innovation Impact Award for Army agentic-AI suite
claims_in_post: Tuknik Government Services, a Koniag subsidiary, recently won the 2026 ACT-IAC Innovation Impact Award for an Army agentic-AI suite the announcement says saves more than $37 million and 687,000 work hours a year

sources.note: out of window; used as recent background context
